# Physlint

Physlint is a local-first, deterministic integrity validator for robot-learning datasets and recordings.

- Project: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint
- Documentation: https://pranayjoshi.github.io/physlint/
- Agent workflow: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/blob/master/docs/agents.md
- Python API: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/blob/master/docs/python-api.md
- JSON Schemas: https://github.com/pranayjoshi/physlint/tree/master/schemas
- Evidence Atlas: https://physlint.com/

Safe machine workflow:
`physlint inspect SOURCE --format json`
`physlint check SOURCE --format json --safe`

Parse stdout on exit 0 or 1. Handled operational errors return JSON on stderr; parser errors on exit 2 may be text. Doctor returns diagnostics on stdout even on exit 2. A pass is not proof of task success, policy quality, calibration, or robot safety.
